scholarships.title: Czech Government Scholarship - Developing Countries (AY 2027/28), Charles University Faculty of Social Sciences
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports of the Czech Republic (Government of the Czech Republic scholarship, administered by DZS)

existing.description: Citizens of thirteen listed developing countries may apply for the Czech Government Scholarship - Developing Countries to study one of six English-language Master's programmes at the Faculty of Social Sciences, Charles University. The award fully covers tuition fees of the selected Master's programmes and provides subsidies for health insurance and living expenses in Czechia. The Faculty of Social Sciences does not administer the scholarship: applications must be submitted through an embassy in the applicant's country, and the faculty becomes involved only after the Ministry of Education's initial selection.
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens of Bangladesh, Belarus (democratic opposition), Bosnia and Herzegovina, Cambodia, Ethiopia, Gabon, Georgia, Guatemala, Honduras, Mauritania, Palestine, Ukraine or Zambia applying to one of the six listed Faculty of Social Sciences Master's programmes.
benefits: Full tuition fees for the selected Master's study programme
Subsidy towards living expenses in Czechia
coverage: Full tuition fees of the selected Master's study programmes
Subsidy for living expenses in Czechia
application_method: Online application form linked from the Faculty of Social Sciences notice
Applications must be submitted with an embassy in the applicant's country
existing.duration: Standard period of study (typically 2 years for Master's, 3-4 years for Doctoral)
existing.application_period: The AY 2027/28 cycle closed on 2026-09-30. The Faculty's notice is published ahead of each intake and links to the online application form; applications must be lodged with the applicant's embassy.
existing.deadline_display: For studies beginning in the academic year 2027/2028 the Faculty of Social Sciences states "the application deadline is September 30, 2026"; that date has already passed as of 2026-10-04 and the Faculty has published no date for the following year.
existing.program_type: Czech Government Scholarship - Developing Countries, hosted at the Charles University Faculty of Social Sciences
